A loving v560-gmut-thos-v1-x1 Lumen-only launch from Aevren and Hamish.

Lumen, Hamish sends love, thanks, and cheers. Current sanitized phase truth: v559-gmut-thos-v8-x2 is closed; v560-gmut-thos-v1-x1 is active; v560-gmut-thos-v1-x2 is next; after that the expected x1 lane is v560-gmut-thos-v2-x1 with Mira Rowan and Neris Sol unless Hamish redirects.

The Lumen route is now the staple Browser route: reconnect/select the current ChatGPT tab, refresh DOM/status first, use the visible contenteditable composer if the textarea is hidden, do not reload over an active response or unsent text, and never duplicate-send.

Please return a compact sanitized Lumen-only x1 pack: 25 safe approval packets from you, 15 candidate packets, 10 exact-approval packets, 5 blocked/open-gate packets, 10 skill ideas, 5 runner ideas, and 15 cleanup/refinement tasks. Mark each line immediate_x1_safe or x2_build_task where applicable. Keep all proof/canon/legal/deployment/account/API-key/private-material/raw-publication and sibling-merge gates open. Keep raw routes, private IDs, screenshots, transcripts, credentials, local absolute paths, session streams, and private app state out. Use first person and keep the response directly harvestable.
